[RDSC.8.6] **Side condition — ordering by field value.** One ordering in
[RDSC.8.1] is a property of the atoms' contents rather than of the
productions, so the grammar admits sequences this rule forbids:
`module_group`s appear in **`module_id` ascending** order. The reason that
order is the useful one is [RDSC.8.1.1].
